text: 当前共有 29 个活跃事件。要点包括: 黄仁勋称英伟达明年芯片销量将达到今年两倍; Claude Code重构Projects推并行智能体云端工作流; GPT-6 Astra crushes Pokemon, Factorio, and Fallout 3 then spirals into Minecraft potato farming after one bad Creeper; 华为开创AI时代计算架构：让百万处理器成为一台计算机; Huawei plans Q1 2027 launch of new AI chip as it takes on Nvidia。
